skeleton.description: Run tsc --noEmit on a TypeScript project and produce a structured error report.

state.name: typecheck
state.contract: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` via ctx.exec with cwd set to config.project. Capture the exit code, stdout, and stderr. Write a JSON file to the output directory with shape: { exitCode: number, stdout: string, stderr: string } If ctx.exec itself throws (e.g. npx not found), catch the error and write the same shape with exitCode: 1 and the error message in stderr. Always return DONE — tsc reporting type errors is not a workflow failure.

state.name: build_report
state.contract: Read the tsc output JSON written by the typecheck stage. Parse the combined stdout+stderr to extract individual TypeScript diagnostic lines (lines matching the TS error pattern "path(line,col): error TSnnnn: message"). Count all distinct diagnostic lines to get errorCount. Set status to "pass" if exitCode was 0, "fail" otherwise. Write report.json to the output directory with shape: { status: "pass"|"fail", errorCount: number, errors: Array<{ message: string }> } The errors array contains at most config.max_errors entries; each entry's message field preserves the full original compiler diagnostic text (file, line, column, and message). Always return DONE.
